mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idle_item (user_id, category_id, item_name, item_desc, hope_exchange, images, item_condition, campus, view_count, status, audit_status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{itemName}, #{itemDesc}, #{hopeExchange}, #{images}, #{itemCondition}, #{campus}, 0, #{status}, #{auditStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE idle_item SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE idle_item SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, u.username, u.avatar AS user_avatar, u.student_no, u.department, c.category_name, 0 AS favorited FROM idle_item i INNER JOIN sys_user u ON i.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN item_category c ON i.category_id = c.id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.create_time DESC

SELECT i.*, u.username, u.avatar AS user_avatar, u.student_no, u.department, c.category_name, 0 AS favorited FROM idle_item i INNER JOIN sys_user u ON i.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN item_category c ON i.category_id = c.id ORDER BY i.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM idle_item WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM idle_item WHERE audit_status = #{auditStatus}
mapper.update: UPDATE idle_item SET audit_status = #{auditStatus}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
